repositories.title: Repositories
repositories.hint: Decide once, now, where the code of this milestone lives. It cannot be changed afterwards.
repositories.reuseExisting: Continue on the codebase of an existing milestone
repositories.noCandidates: This course has no other milestone whose codebase could be continued yet.
repositories.reuseConsequences: This milestone shares the template repository with the selected milestone, and every student keeps working in the repository they already have. It gets its own test repository, so it is graded by its own tests, and its own solution repository, starting as a copy of the selected milestone's solution. Programming language, project type, package name and static code analysis are taken over from it.

testCaseCoverage.title: Test Case Coverage
testCaseCoverage.orphansTitle: Test cases not assigned to any user story
testCaseCoverage.orphansHint: Students cannot earn points for these test cases, because only the test cases referenced by a user story are graded. Reference them from a user story's problem statement.
testCaseCoverage.duplicatesTitle: Test cases assigned to several user stories
testCaseCoverage.duplicatesHint: These test cases are graded once per user story that references them, so students receive their points more than once. Reference each test case from exactly one user story.
